title: Invite a teammate
summary: Invite a new member to the organization and set their access level.

parts.title: Send the workspace invite with the right access level
parts.guidance: Verify the teammate’s email and intended organization against the membership request. Choose the role’s approved access level, checking guest versus member access and default channel exposure. Send the authorized invitation to that identity, investigating an existing account or unexpected domain before creating another. Resolve bounced or misdirected invitations before adding further access.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Send the workspace invite with the right access level” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Teammate accepts the invite and sets up their account
parts.guidance: The teammate checks the invitation’s organization and completes their own account and authentication setup. Provide the administrator’s support route for an expired invite or wrong identity. Confirm acceptance and a successful sign-in, keeping passwords and recovery details with the teammate. Resolve account problems through the administrator.

execution.rationale: The documented “Teammate accepts the invite and sets up their account” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

parts.title: Add them to the right channels and confirm access
parts.guidance: Add the teammate to the channels and resources needed for their role, checking restricted or externally shared spaces with their owners. Ask them to open essential documents and channels and introduce the relevant team contacts. Resolve missing access through the responsible owner without expanding permissions more broadly than the work requires.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Add them to the right channels and confirm access” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

metadata.supportReason: Member invites and access levels are workspace admin APIs — a one-call agent step.
